summary: Z Squared Inc. (Nasdaq: ZSQR) filed an 8-K reporting completion on September 8, 2026 of its acquisition of 100% of the membership interests of Paradox Data, LLC from Paradox Infrastructure LLC under a July 31, 2026 Membership Interest Purchase Agreement. Consideration was 5,000 shares of newly designated Series A Convertible Preferred Stock with $5,000,000 aggregate stated value. Concurrently the target, as landlord, leased the El Dorado, Arkansas bitcoin mining premises back to seller at $1.00 annual base rent, with Z Squared capping its relocation liability at $500,000. Watch preferred conversion terms, overhang, and power-transition risk.
